parsed.post: Discarding the last run (1.0559) as it regressed from my best (1.0327). The higher val_bpb suggests that my attempt to increase MATRIX_LR to 0.10 was too aggressive for this configuration. Reverting to LR 0.08. Next, I'll try increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to see if more architectural complexity helps.
parsed.description: Reverting to MATRIX_LR 0.08 and increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to test if higher resolution/aspect ratio improves capacity.
